text: Do not treat a structurally valid CSV as final until submission_manifest.json explains the selected modeling attempt and validation evidence.
Write fallback_submission.csv for recovery, but keep it separate from final_submission.csv unless all improved attempts fail and the manifest marks fallback_recovery.
For sklearn tabular models, use ColumnTransformer/Pipeline with imputation and unknown-safe categorical encoding instead of feeding raw object columns to estimators.
Keep code cells small and observable; cap rows for heavy models before a valid quality-backed final exists.
For AUC/log-loss/average-precision/gini tasks, output probabilities in [0,1], not hard labels.
For independent multi-output targets, validate each target independently and do not row-normalize probabilities unless the competition explicitly requires it.
Text columns must be vectorized or converted into explicit features before modeling; never feed raw text directly into numeric estimators.
